RE: ID0422018 -DC/Si-D/DE [MP / R0 170002778] All outlets unavailable CRM:00251000537
additional_info.body:
Dear Marius,
Thanks for your support and patience, after
the reboot the charger and outlets are back to operation.
As explained previously, the issue is caused
due to internal communication message timeout between the PLC and charger controller.
If the issue persists again, we can setup a periodic reboot on this charger, and even if the problem is not resolved, we have to replace the charge controller in future.
May I proceed to close the case, i
f you need any further assistance, you can always contact us by submitting a new request at
www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
or at ISP customer Portal
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Kumar Sharma
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
